state.failed: Couldn't load what the workshop said

problem.read: The server didn't answer as expected. Try again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not see or do this.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
problem.gone: It no longer exists, or it belongs to another company.
problem.write: It was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed the order meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try again.
problem.state: The order moved on meanwhile: it was read again. Check what it allows now.
problem.invalid: Something in it was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
problem.slowDown: Too many tries at once. Wait a moment and try again.

held.manage: Your role may not act for the workshop: it needs the right to manage subcontract orders.
held.receive: Your role may not receive goods back from a workshop.
held.answered: The workshop answered this job already.
held.declinePartly: Some of the work came back already: it can no longer be declined.
held.notSent: The order has not gone to the workshop yet.
held.acceptFirst: The workshop has not accepted the job yet: record its answer first.
held.kitNone: No kit line waits for the workshop's check.
held.noKitYet: The kit has not left yet: nothing can come back.
held.nothingToAnnounce: Everything at the workshop is announced or back already.
held.generic: Not possible on this order now.

link.accepted: The workshop accepted already: no link is needed.
link.draft: Send the order to the workshop first.

date.none: The workshop proposed no other date.
date.answered: We answered the proposed date already.

answer.title: The job
answer.waiting: Sent to the workshop: waiting for its answer (accept, another date, or decline).
answer.notSent: Not sent to the workshop yet.
answer.dateAccepted: We accepted that day on {when}: it is the expected-back day.
answer.dateRefused: We refused that day on {when}: our day stays.

held.past: The day it proposes is today or later.
held.same: That is our day: record it as accepted as asked.
held.reason: Say why it needs another day.
held.note: Say why in a few words.

reach.title: How the workshop answers

none.title: No e-mail and no portal for this workshop
none.body: Record its answers here when it tells you by phone or on paper: they are kept as given for it by the office.

reach.portal: Its portal is on: {count} person(s) may answer there.

handed.title: The job link, to pass on now
handed.once: It is shown this once and not kept: copy it now (for a message to the workshop).

link.title: Send job {number} to the workshop
link.what: One phone page, no install and no price: the job, the sizes, the kit day and the due-back day; the workshop accepts, proposes another date or declines.
link.mailHint: We mail it to the workshop from this order.
link.hand: Get the link to pass on
link.handHint: For a workshop without e-mail: you send it yourself (a message on the phone).
link.language: Language of the page and the mail
link.replaces: The open link stops working: the new one replaces it.

held.address: Give the address the link goes to.

date.acceptWhat: The order's expected-back day becomes {day} (it was {asked}).
date.refuseWhat: Our day {asked} stays; the workshop reads that we refused {day}.

dialog.forWorkshop: You write this for the workshop (it has no e-mail or told you by phone): it is kept as given by the office.
dialog.name: Who at the workshop said so
dialog.nameHint: Optional: else your name is kept.

answerDialog.title: The workshop's answer on job {number}
answerDialog.acceptHint: The pieces, the sizes and our due-back day.
answerDialog.moveHint: We answer the day it proposes.

kit.title: Kit received by the workshop
kit.noneSent: No kit line has left yet.

held.count: Line {line}: count what came (0 or more).
held.note: Line {line}: say what is missing or damaged.

kitDialog.title: The kit the workshop received for job {number}
kitDialog.photos: A photo of damage comes from the workshop's portal; here the words are kept.

held.nothing: Type the finished pieces of at least one size.
held.finishBy: The finish day is after the order day.

held.reason: Line {line}: say why pieces were scrapped.
held.more: Line {line}: at most {left} are at the workshop and not announced.
held.nothing: Say what comes back: at least one piece.
held.day: The goods arrive today or later.
held.ddtNumber: A DDT date needs its number.
held.ddtDate: The DDT is dated on or before the day the goods arrive.

returnsDialog.title: What comes back on job {number}
returnsDialog.nothingMoves: Nothing moves in stock until the goods are received back.
returnsDialog.left: At the workshop and not announced: {left} · finished and ready: {ready}
returnsDialog.ddtHint: As printed on its transport document.
returnsDialog.weCollect: We collect the goods (else the workshop delivers)

cancelReturn.title: Cancel send-back no. {seq}
cancelReturn.what: The {pieces} piece(s) announced will not come as announced; nothing moves in stock.
cancelReturn.final: A cancelled send-back stays in the list; the workshop announces again.

refused.proposedDate: The proposed day was not accepted: from today on, not our day.
refused.address: That address cannot take the link: check it.
refused.scrapReason: Pick why the pieces were scrapped.
refused.kit: A kit line was not accepted: count again.
refused.progress: A count is more than the pieces left: check the sizes.
refused.material: A material line was not accepted: check the quantities.
refused.returns: More pieces than are at the workshop: check the lines.
refused.day: The goods arrive today or later.
refused.ddt: The DDT was not accepted: its number, and its date not after arrival.

notice.linkSent: The job link went to the workshop.
notice.linkHanded: The job link is ready to pass on: copy it now.
notice.dateAccepted: Date accepted: the expected-back day moved.
notice.kit: The workshop's kit check is recorded.
notice.progress: The finished pieces are recorded: the work order sees them.
notice.returns: The send-back is recorded: receive it when the goods arrive.
